text: This is a heart, cut open so we can see inside it.
It has four chambers, two on each side, with thick muscle walls.
Each beat starts with the top two chambers squeezing first.
Then the bottom two chambers squeeze hard and push blood out.
Valves open and shut so blood only moves in one direction.
Blood from the body returns to the right side, goes to the lungs, then comes back to the left.
From the left ventricle, blood leaves through the aorta to the whole body.
